name: crewframe-workspace
description: Runs the CrewFrame backend, main site, and admin panel together for local development.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix crewframe-backend && npm install --prefix crewframe-app && npm install --prefix crewframe-admin
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,site,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix crewframe-backend" "npm run dev --prefix crewframe-app" "npm run dev --prefix crewframe-admin"
